title: Venus: Where a Day Outlasts a Year
hook: Your calendar on Venus would tear itself apart.
hook_headline: ONE DAY = LONGER THAN A YEAR
script: Your calendar on Venus would tear itself apart. What if you tried to live out a single year there? You wouldn't even finish one day, because a Venus day of 243 Earth days outlasts its 225-day year. The Sun there rises in the west and sets in the east, spinning backward like a broken music box. That retrograde spin is why a day so long feels like it bends time itself. The air would crush you long before you noticed.
